purpose: Implement the FT-001 local session lifecycle and the internal activation handoff primitive needed by FT-003.
success_outcome: Local credentials and sessions can be issued, validated, revoked, and fail-closed against Account and FarmMembership status.
anti_goals: No hosted recovery or email delivery.

forbidden_scope: FT-003 public local invite activation route

success_checks: Login creates a new LocalSession and does not revive expired or revoked sessions.
Logout revokes only the current session and invalid/missing logout can be idempotent.
Session validity is fail-closed from session, Account, and FarmMembership status.
Internal activation primitive activates Account/FarmMembership and issues a session only after FT-003 validates invite credentials.
T3 closure includes /verify PASS, /red-verify semantic-pass, HUMAN_CHECKPOINT: done, and ROLLBACK_RECOVERY_NOTE: present.
evidence_required: internal activation primitive evidence without public FT-003 route implementation

stop_conditions: Session lifecycle cannot be proven fail-closed.
Implementation requires public FT-003 route ownership.
Raw auth material would enter persistence, logs, or evidence.
